basis: Account-level aggregates only (get_history returns 400, so no per-post rows). Directives below are traceable to the baseline report but rest on a small, coarse sample.
experiments: Comment-first CTAs on the majority of posts until comment count is non-zero
COMPARE-SPLIT same-calorie post as the save/share test
notes: Baseline: TikTok 668 views / 17 posts / 2 likes / 0 comments / 0 shares; YouTube 433 views / 3 likes / 0 comments. Zero comments across 17 posts is the headline problem and it is a content signal, not an algorithm signal, so weight this batch toward comment-earning formats (GUESS quizzes, ranking debates). Both platforms show a hard distribution collapse right after five simultaneous posts on 22 July, so hold cadence at 2 posts/day with wide spacing and do not chase volume. Instagram and Facebook are unlinked, so this batch is TikTok plus YouTube only.
